text:
maria: FYI the external testers delivered a prioritized report. Two high-risk items: a KMS policy misuse allowing broad decrypt paths, and an assume-role vector that can swap service tokens. Need quick containment + retest plan.

jordan: Got the report. Short labels: KMS-EXP (policy condition too broad) and ASSUME-TOOL (role chaining allowed). Repro steps in PDF. Immediate mitigation: tighten kms:Decrypt to resource ARNs, remove sts:AssumeRole from the worker role.

lee: We should avoid rotating customer keys during the operation window. Suggest creating a read-only KMS proxy in staging to capture policy behaviour without touching production keys.

sanjay: I'll stand up the SIEM stream and ensure KMS and STS events are indexed. Plan: enable detailed audit forwarding for the readroom and create a temporary SIEM index. Also will tag affected keys with `pt:locked` so we can filter telemetry.

maria: Proposed steps: (1) deploy kms-proxy to staging, (2) apply RBAC policy diffs in a canary namespace, (3) produce an evidence bundle (policy diffs, logs, reproducible testcases), (4) schedule 4-hour readroom for the retest. Windows: Wed 2026-02-18 01:00-05:00 UTC or Fri 2026-02-20 23:00-03:00 UTC. Leaning to Wed. @nina-qa can you run the verification harness?

nina-qa: I can run it. I'll craft ~10 smoke cases and a small harness that runs through the exploit path plus normal flows. Need proxy endpoint, policy diffs, and at least 7 days of audit logs available.

jordan: I'll create a minimal tracker sheet with finding_id, component, mitigation_pr, evidence_link, owner, target_retest_window. Please keep PRs policy-only to minimize review time.

lee: Ops note: the proxy must surface a caller-id header and reject requests missing it. Example nginx snippet: ```location /kms-proxy/ { proxy_pass http://kms-stub.internal; proxy_set_header X-Caller-Id $http_x_caller_id; }``` We'll also implement a latency guard: if crypto ops exceed 150ms, route to passive replica and notify assessor.

sanjay: Also: ship KMS:Decrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey, and sts:AssumeRole events. Set retention to 7 days for fine-grained logs for the readroom; archive the window to the evidence bucket.

maria: I'll create the artifact bucket and a presigned link for the assessor. Ops: tag the deploys with `pt-thread-4311112222` so we can filter traces.

jordan: Pushing first PRs to branches `canary/rbac-lockdown` and `staging/kms-proxy`. Will post links and update the tracker.

maria: Volunteers: jordan (PRs + tracker), nina-qa (harness + verify), lee (proxy + fallback), sanjay (audit + SIEM), maria (evidence handoff + schedule).

nina-qa: Quick Q: should we include a controlled seeded positive for the assume-role finding so assessors can validate detection?

maria: Yes, include one seeded case in the artifact manifest and clearly mark it with timestamps; keep production logs separate.

deploy-bot: Dry-run scheduled: staging deployment (kms-proxy) at 2026-02-17T23:45:00Z.

jordan: For acceptance we'll require: (A) policy diffs applied & logged, (B) zero cross-account Decrypts for 2 hours post-deploy, (C) harness passes. If met, mark KMS-EXP remediated.

lee: I'll prepare fallback script and include failover instructions in the runbook.

maria: I'll ping legal for evidence transfer and ops-sre for the readroom ops. Post the presigned link here once available. If any blockers arise, report here.
